about_the_game:
Hentai Travel - Solve puzzles of varying difficulty. The best solution for relaxation. There are 3 difficulty modes for each player. Easy is perfect for those who like to quickly complete several levels. Medium is more challenging and requires attention. Hard is for the more experienced players. If things get tough, just press the auto button. The game allows you to save all your artwork to your computer. Earn achievements by completing levels, and each level has its own achievement.

Game Features

  • 30 illustrations

  • 30 achievements

  • Relaxing music

  • 3 difficulty modes
